name: ChupathingyCE Dedicated Server
author: 29721813+JizzyRivers@users.noreply.github.com
description: Halo: Combat Evolved dedicated server from ChupathingyCE. Hosts games around the clock from a playlist, listed on halo.milenko.org and in the ChupathingyCE/OpenCE Server Browser. Internet play uses the primary allocation (UDP). You supply the game's maps.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# ChupathingyCE Dedicated Server installer (runs in ghcr.io/pterodactyl/installers:alpine)
set -eu

apk add --no-cache curl unzip jq ca-certificates >/dev/null

REPO=ChupathingyCE/chupathingyce
cd /mnt/server

# Which server: the node's architecture unless the variable says otherwise.
ARCH="${SERVER_ARCH:-auto}"
if [ "$ARCH" = auto ]; then
	case "$(uname -m)" in
		x86_64) ARCH=x64 ;;
		aarch64|arm64) ARCH=arm64 ;;
		i?86) ARCH=x86 ;;
		*) echo "unsupported architecture $(uname -m)"; exit 1 ;;
	esac
fi

if [ -z "${VERSION:-}" ] || [ "$VERSION" = latest ]; then
	TAG=$(curl -fsSL "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/releases/latest" | jq -r .tag_name)
else
	TAG="$VERSION"
fi
[ -n "$TAG" ] && [ "$TAG" != null ] || { echo "could not find the release"; exit 1; }

ZIP="chupathingyce-server-linux-$ARCH.zip"
BASE="https://github.com/$REPO/releases/download/$TAG"
echo "Installing $ZIP from $TAG"

# Downloads go in the server folder: the install container's /tmp is a small
# tmpfs (Wings' tmpfs_size, 100 MB by default), too small for a maps archive.
TMP=/mnt/server/.egg-tmp
rm -rf "$TMP" && mkdir -p "$TMP"
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
curl -fsSL -o "$TMP/$ZIP" "$BASE/$ZIP"
curl -fsSL -o "$TMP/SHA256SUMS" "$BASE/SHA256SUMS"
(cd "$TMP" && grep "  $ZIP\$" SHA256SUMS | sha256sum -c -)
unzip -o -q "$TMP/$ZIP" -d "$TMP/x"

install -m 755 "$TMP/x/chupathingyce-server" ./chupathingyce-server
cat > start.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/ash
# ChupathingyCE Dedicated Server launcher for Pterodactyl.
# The egg's installer writes this file; reinstalling the server rewrites it.
cd /home/container || exit 1

# The data folder is the server's home; saves, cache and logs inside it so
# they're in backups and visible over SFTP.
export HALO_DATA_ROOT=/home/container
export HALO_SAVE_ROOT=/home/container/saves
export HALO_CACHE_ROOT=/home/container/cache
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/tmp

# Internet play on the server's primary allocation (UDP). Docker publishes it,
# so the server is reachable the same way as a port-forwarded home server.
export HALO_NET_TUNNEL_PORT="${SERVER_PORT}"
export HALO_NET_ALLOW_UPNP=false

# Pterodactyl's console feeds stdin; read it even if it isn't a terminal.
export HALO_DEDICATED_CONSOLE=true

# The control panel, on a second allocation, when one is given.
if [ -n "${CONTROL_PORT:-}" ]; then
	export HALO_DEDICATED_CONTROL="0.0.0.0:${CONTROL_PORT}"
fi

# Blank panel variables mean "the server's default, or what sv_set / the
# control panel saved in admin/settings.toml": drop them from the environment
# so they don't override that file.
for v in $(env | sed -n 's/^\(HALO_[A-Z0-9_]*\)=$/\1/p'); do
	unset "$v"
done

if [ ! -f maps/ui.map ]; then
	echo "[egg] maps/ui.map is missing: upload ui.map and the multiplayer maps"
	echo "[egg] to the maps/ folder over SFTP (see the egg's notes), then start again."
	exit 1
fi

exec ./chupathingyce-server
EOF
chmod 755 start.sh
mkdir -p maps maps_ce maps_md maps_pc playlists saves cache logs licenses
# The release's playlists and name list are refreshed on every reinstall;
# keep your own playlists under other names (or make them in the control
# panel, which saves them in admin/).
cp -f "$TMP"/x/playlists/*.txt playlists/
cp -f "$TMP/x/blocked_names.txt" ./blocked_names.txt
cp -f "$TMP/x/README.md" ./SERVER_README.md
cp -f "$TMP"/x/*LICENSE* "$TMP"/x/*COPYING* "$TMP"/x/*OFL* "$TMP"/x/*CC0* licenses/ 2>/dev/null || true

# Optional: your own archive of the game's maps (zip or tar.gz, holding maps/
# and any of maps_ce/, maps_md/, maps_pc/ at its top). Fetched only while
# maps/ui.map is missing, so a reinstall doesn't download it again.
if [ -n "${MAPS_URL:-}" ] && [ ! -f maps/ui.map ]; then
	echo "Fetching maps from MAPS_URL"
	if curl -fsSL -o "$TMP/maps.archive" "$MAPS_URL"; then
		if unzip -tq "$TMP/maps.archive" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
			unzip -o -q "$TMP/maps.archive" -d /mnt/server || echo "warning: could not unpack the maps archive"
		else
			tar -xzf "$TMP/maps.archive" -C /mnt/server || echo "warning: could not unpack the maps archive"
		fi
		rm -f "$TMP/maps.archive"
	else
		echo "warning: could not download MAPS_URL; upload the maps over SFTP instead"
	fi
	[ -f maps/ui.map ] || echo "warning: still no maps/ui.map"
fi

# Optional: Custom Edition maps from the community map repository
# (maps.halonet.net, then its mirrors), the same copies ChupathingyCE players
# download when they join a game on a map they don't have. A player's download
# must be the host's version of the map, so the server plays the repository's
# copy. Fetched only while maps_ce/<name>.map is missing.
if [ -n "${CE_MAPS:-}" ]; then
	[ "$ARCH" = x86 ] && echo "warning: the x86 server can't play Custom Edition maps; use x64 or arm64"
	for m in $(echo "$CE_MAPS" | tr 'A-Z,' 'a-z '); do
		if [ -f "maps_ce/$m.map" ]; then
			echo "maps_ce/$m.map is already there"
			continue
		fi
		got=
		for r in https://maps.halonet.net https://maps2.halonet.net https://maps1.halonet.net; do
			if curl -fsSL -o "$TMP/$m.zip" "$r/halonet/locator.php?format=zip&map=$m&type=halom"; then
				got=$r
				break
			fi
		done
		if [ -z "$got" ]; then
			echo "warning: the community map repositories don't have $m.map"
			continue
		fi
		entry=$(unzip -Z1 "$TMP/$m.zip" 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "(^|/)$m\.map\$" | head -n 1)
		if [ -n "$entry" ] && unzip -p "$TMP/$m.zip" "$entry" > "$TMP/$m.map" && [ -s "$TMP/$m.map" ]; then
			mv "$TMP/$m.map" "maps_ce/$m.map"
			echo "Installed maps_ce/$m.map from $got"
		else
			echo "warning: no $m.map in the archive from $got"
		fi
		rm -f "$TMP/$m.zip" "$TMP/$m.map"
	done
	for f in bitmaps sounds loc; do
		[ -f "maps_ce/$f.map" ] || echo "warning: Custom Edition maps need maps_ce/$f.map (upload it from your Custom Edition install)"
	done
fi

echo "$TAG ($ARCH)" > .egg-version
echo "Installed ChupathingyCE server $TAG ($ARCH)."
[ -f maps/ui.map ] || echo "Next: upload ui.map and the multiplayer maps to maps/ over SFTP."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name on halo.milenko.org and the Server Browser. 15 characters at most.

variables.name: Playlist
variables.description: A playlist inside the server folder: playlists/free_for_all.txt, slayer.txt, team_slayer.txt, small_maps.txt, big_maps.txt, bloodgulch.txt, gearbox.txt, or your own.

variables.name: Maximum players
variables.description: Players a game takes (server default 12). Blank: the server's default, or what the control panel / sv_set saved.

variables.name: Minimum players
variables.description: Players a game waits for before its countdown (server default 1). Blank: the server's default, or what the control panel / sv_set saved.

variables.name: Idle limit (minutes)
variables.description: End a game nobody has scored in for this long; 0 never (server default 5). Blank: the server's default, or what the control panel / sv_set saved.

variables.name: Public
variables.description: true: listed in the in-game Server Browser. false: only the game list and invite links.

variables.name: Welcome message
variables.description: Chat message ChupathingyCE players get as they join (printable ASCII). Blank: the server's default, or what the control panel / sv_set saved.

variables.name: Post-game seconds
variables.description: How long the carnage report shows (server default 20). Blank: the server's default, or what the control panel / sv_set saved.

variables.name: Skip lobby
variables.description: true: start the next game at once when enough players stayed. Blank: the server's default, or what the control panel / sv_set saved.

variables.name: Name filter
variables.description: true: warn and kick players with a name in blocked_names.txt. Blank: the server's default, or what the control panel / sv_set saved.

variables.name: Chat
variables.description: 2 on, 1 team chat only, 0 off. Blank: the server's default, or what the control panel / sv_set saved.

variables.name: Startup commands file
variables.description: A file in the server folder with one console command a line, run once the server hosts (e.g. startup.txt).

variables.name: Control panel port
variables.description: Turns on the web control panel / API on this port. It must be one of this server's allocations (add a second one). HTTPS with the server's own certificate: check the fingerprint the console prints. Blank: off.

variables.name: Control panel TLS
variables.description: auto/on: HTTPS (required on a public address).

variables.name: List on halo.milenko.org
variables.description: false: not on the game list (invites and the Server Browser still work).

variables.name: Delta Stats
variables.description: Send each game's events (kills, positions, medals...) to halo.milenko.org for match pages and leaderboards. Player names only, never addresses.

variables.name: Events token
variables.description: A token from the game list's operator: games count as a trusted server's.

variables.name: Server build
variables.description: auto: the node's architecture. x86 (32-bit) runs on x64 nodes too and uses less memory, but is meant for Xbox maps; use x64/arm64 for Custom Edition and HaloMD maps. Reinstall to apply.

variables.name: Version
variables.description: A release tag (v0.7.5d) or latest. Reinstall to update.

variables.name: Maps archive URL
variables.description: Optional: a zip or tar.gz of YOUR OWN copy of the maps (maps/ui.map etc. at its top), fetched at install while maps/ui.map is missing. Otherwise upload over SFTP.

variables.name: Custom Edition maps
variables.description: Optional: Custom Edition maps to fetch into maps_ce/ from the community map repository (maps.halonet.net), the copies players download when they join, e.g. new_mombasa_classic. Commas between names. Play them as <name>@ce in a playlist. Reinstall to apply.
